name: Uminekozawa Meron
source:
1st year student. Like Soremi, she is the protagonist's childhood friend, as well as his first love. She has common sense, but also a passionate side, which led her to enroll to the same school as the protagonist for the purpose of being with him. The writer of Death Girl.

She shares her name with [url=https://vndb.org/s10871]Uminekozawa Melon[/url], the writer of the visual novel.
